summary: First full end-to-end test run for Sujal Gupta portfolio (both backend + frontend). 7/7 pytest backend tests pass (health, root, contact create + Mongo persistence, contact validation, /api/github/profile shape + caching, /api/resume/download PDF). Playwright smoke of the live preview URL exercises loader, hero (rotating role, 5 stat cards, portrait, three.js particles), navbar (glass-on-scroll, all 7 nav links, mobile hamburger + mobile nav-link scroll), every section id (about/education/experience/skills/projects/certifications/achievements/workflow/why-hire-me/github/contact), all 6 project GitHub + Live buttons + 7th CTA, 10 workflow steps, GitHub stats live API render (4 stat tiles + contribution graph img + top repos), contact form submit shows success and doc lands in Mongo. 60/61 checks pass on first pass; the 1 failure (mobile-menu-toggle outside viewport) was purely a scroll-position artifact of the previous test — retested from y=0 and mobile menu opens + mobile nav-link scrolls to #projects successfully. Overall: build is healthy, no functional bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: Framer Motion useScroll warnings ('provided ref is not yet hydrated' / 'container has a non-static position') fire on load — non-blocking but easy to fix by moving useScroll into the same component that owns the ref (e.g. Experience/Education TimelineRail receives the ref via prop rather than being defined higher up) and ensuring the scroll container has position:relative. Cosmetic only.
THREE.Clock deprecation warning from three.js — will need to migrate to THREE.Timer eventually, not urgent.
GitHub proxy uses unauthenticated public API (60 req/hr). Cache is a single global in-memory dict — fine for a single-instance portfolio; document the limit.

Contact endpoint always returns 200 even if the Resend email call fails (send_email swallows the exception and logs). Correct per spec ('submission still saves even if email fails') — no action needed, just calling it out.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_-prefixed contact submissions were created during backend + frontend runs; both cleaned up (mongo contact_submissions collection has 0 TEST_ rows remaining).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (reads BASE_URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, MONGO_URL + DB_NAME from backend/.env). Run: `python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Preview URL is https://sujal-minimal.preview.emergentagent.com. Mobile menu test must be run from window.scrollTo(0,0) because navbar auto-hides on scroll-down (this is intended UX, not a bug). GitHub proxy responded 200 during this run — if you get 502 during future runs, that's the documented public-API rate limit and is acceptable per spec.
